newsitem.title: UK: Stg/mark off peak, hovers above 2.73 marks.
newsitem.headline: Stg/mark off peak, hovers above 2.73 marks.

text.p: 1120 GMT - Sterling off highs, hovering above 2.73 marks in Europe after bouncing from lows at 2.7245, but capped as UK rate rise expectations lose steam.
* UK April producer input prices fall 1.9 pct m/m vs 0.5 pct fall forecast, down 0.8 pct previously. Output prices up 0.2 pct vs forecast 0.1 pct.
* Sterling/mark at 2.7380/90 vs 2.7315/45 in late Europe on Friday. Cable at $1.6170/80 vs $1.6208/18 Friday.
* Bank of England governor George says he expects inflation to decline in coming months and that there is a better or even chance of meeting government's inflation targets.
* George declined to comment on whether he saw further need for rise in interest rates, saying BoE's view on interest rates would be contained in its monthly inflation report due Tuesday.
